# Release Gate Checklist: Rebrand and Consolidate GPT-RAG into Agent Landing Zone

**Purpose**: Validate that the requirements for naming, delivery phases, repositories, infrastructure incorporation, deployment layers, and documentation are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable before planning
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Naming and Branding

- [x] CHK001 - Is the exact form of the transition statement defined, so that FR-001 and the FR-002 exception can be applied consistently across the landing page, documentation, and release notes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 - Does the spec define the naming convention for replacement identifiers (casing, prefixes, and abbreviations such as "alz" or "agentlz") that replace each "gpt-rag" variant? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 - Is "historical record" defined precisely enough to classify changelog entries, ADRs, specs, and release notes in the naming inventory? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the list of surfaces covered by FR-002 complete for the component repositories (package names, container image tags, Foundry agent names, and telemetry service names)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK005 - Are the visual identity requirements for the UI (logo asset, product text, and title) specified with a source or owner for the new assets? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK006 - Is the acceptance of the name collision with the internal Copilot Studio offering reflected in a requirement about how public material avoids confusing the two? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Delivery Phases and Dates

- [x] CHK007 - Is it specified which user stories and acceptance scenarios must pass at the preview and which only at `v4.0.0`? For example, User Story 1 scenario 3 requires no GPT-RAG naming, but the runtime identifiers change only in Phase 2. [Conflict, Spec §User Story 1, §Delivery Phases]
- [x] CHK008 - Is FR-018 (deployment options on the landing page) consistent with Phase 1, given that the infrastructure-only option ships only in Phase 2? [Conflict, Spec §FR-018, §Delivery Phases]
- [x] CHK009 - Is the User Story 3 rationale ("can be delivered after the deployment experience works") consistent with the Phase 1 minimal documentation section? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 3, §Delivery Phases]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the minimum content of the Phase 1 "minimal Agent Landing Zone section" defined? [Clarity, Spec §Delivery Phases, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK011 - Are the success criteria that apply to the preview (SC-002 to SC-006) explicitly scoped by phase, like SC-008 does for naming? [Gap, Spec §SC-002 to §SC-008]
- [x] CHK012 - Are the decision criteria and fallback defined if a phase misses its date, for example publishing partially or moving the date? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK013 - Are the preview's release requirements (pre-release marking, "not for production" wording, and redeploy notice) stated as functional requirements rather than only as assumptions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §Assumptions]

## Repositories, Releases, and Links

- [x] CHK014 - Are the version numbers of the renamed component repositories specified for each phase, including whether they also start a new major or a preview? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK015 - Is the order of operations for the rename (component releases, repository renames, manifest update, and umbrella release) specified in enough detail to avoid broken pins in between? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007, §Delivery Phases]
- [x] CHK016 - Are the requirements for rolling back a repository rename defined if a problem is found after it? [Gap, Recovery Flow, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK017 - Is re-verification of name availability tied to a defined moment and owner, and is a fallback name specified if a name is taken? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK018 - Are downstream artifacts that embed repository names (published container images, workflow references, badges, and forks) addressed by requirements? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK019 - Is User Story 4 scenario 2 (every short link resolves) consistent with short links being non-blocking and possibly pending? [Conflict, Spec §User Story 4, §FR-020, §Delivery Phases]
- [x] CHK020 - Is the list of existing GPT-RAG short links, and of the desired new ones, identified or referenced so that SC-003 can be measured? [Measurability, Spec §FR-020, §SC-003]

## Infrastructure Incorporation

- [x] CHK021 - Is the infrastructure version to incorporate identified (the currently pinned version, or a newer one)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010a, §FR-010b]
- [x] CHK022 - Is "produce the same resources, apart from the renamed identifiers" defined with a measurable comparison method and tolerated differences? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010b]
- [x] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for keeping the incorporated infrastructure's history, license, and contribution attribution? [Gap, Spec §FR-010a]
- [x] CHK024 - Are the exact wording, placement, and link of the README notice in `Azure/bicep-ptn-aiml-landing-zone` specified, and is it stated whether that repository is archived or only frozen? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010d]
- [x] CHK025 - Are requirements defined for the open issues and pull requests in `Azure/bicep-ptn-aiml-landing-zone` at the time of incorporation? [Gap, Spec §FR-010d]
- [x] CHK026 - Are the Terraform parity expectations for the renamed identifiers and the infrastructure-only option specified, or explicitly excluded? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-010c, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK027 - Is it defined how the infrastructure's own validation (Bicep validation and parity workflows) becomes part of the release gate in FR-024? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010c, §FR-024]

## Deployment Layers

- [x] CHK028 - Is the boundary between "foundation" and "application-specific configuration" defined with a list of which resources and settings belong to each layer? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK029 - Is the operator's way to select the deployment option specified at the requirement level (single choice, default, and how it is changed later)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §FR-013]
- [x] CHK030 - Are requirements defined for removing the application layer from an environment that has it, which the edge cases say must be "explicit and confirmed"? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK031 - Is the "clear message" in FR-016 and User Story 2 scenario 3 specified with the minimum information it must contain? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, §User Story 2]
- [x] CHK032 - Does a requirement cover the hosted-agent naming consistency between configuration, image registry, and Foundry, which is listed only as an edge case? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-014]
- [x] CHK033 - Is "replaceable unit" in FR-015 defined in terms of the contract between the foundation and an application pattern? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK034 - Are network-isolation and security posture requirements stated for the infrastructure-only option, not only for the application layer? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, §FR-014]

## Documentation and Governance

- [x] CHK035 - Is it defined what happens to the former GPT-RAG documentation site and the `docs` branch after the move (redirect, freeze, or archive)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK036 - Is the page-by-page mapping from the former documentation to the central site required as an artifact, so that SC-004 can be measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK037 - Are the approval owners for the constitution amendment and the ADR identified, given that they gate all other work? [Dependency, Spec §FR-022, §FR-023]
- [x] CHK038 - Is the dependency on the `Azure/AI-Landing-Zones` site (write access, review, and publishing process) documented as an assumption or requirement? [Dependency, Assumption, Spec §FR-017]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK039 - Is the scope of the "automated scan" in SC-001 defined (which repositories, which artifacts, and which deployed resources)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK040 - Is the baseline for "within 10% of the equivalent GPT-RAG deployment" in SC-002 defined, including region and configuration? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK041 - Is the list of "every functional capability documented for the last GPT-RAG release" in SC-006 defined or referenced? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
